title: Choose the Pit-Wall composition
question: The visual world is locked. Choose the mobile hierarchy that should govern the production build.

options.label: Load-First Ledger
options.lineage: Pit-board prescription plus vertical set sheet
options.thesis: The required load is unmistakable from a meter away, then the eye falls directly into the set sequence.
options.viewport: A dominant load block, vertical set ledger, and fixed next-set command.
options.risk: The prescription area consumes more space before the accessory work appears.

options.label: Live Set Ledger
options.lineage: F1 sector timing board and driver control deck
options.thesis: The active set expands inside the session ledger, keeping context and logging controls visible together.
options.viewport: An expanded current set inside a dense ledger with load, reps, RPE, and log controls below.
options.risk: It is the densest option and requires disciplined responsive reduction.

options.label: Session Command
options.lineage: Pre-race command panel and timing manifest
options.thesis: The dashboard makes starting today’s workout the unmistakable event, with the full prescription visible beneath it.
options.viewport: An asymmetric start panel, week rail, session manifest, and recent result.
options.risk: The large start control is excellent before training but less useful once a session is underway.
